title: Halifax Summer Breeze Sail
blurb: This two-hour sail allows you to soak in the sights along the coastline so close to our urban center! Pass by landmarks such as George's Island, Pier 21, Point Pleasant Park, and more. This laid-back sail is designed for you to enjoy maximum relaxation, and leave the work to our crew. If you'd like to be involved in the sailing, we would love the opportunity to show you the ropes! After being greeted with a custom local cocktail (or mocktail!) upon arrival, you can choose to explore the sailing yacht, take in the sights, or try your hand at the helm.
